title: Ember Gland
html:
Monster drop: Baby Red Dragon

What it’s for

An enchant reagent. Each infuse (one carat more) and each re-enchant to one of these uses one:

  • of the Flame (gems: Onyx + Topaz + Ruby)
  • staff of Fire (gems: Amber + Ruby + Ruby)
  • Iolite rings and pendants (their gem: Gem Iolite)

Dropped by Dragon: Baby Red Dragon, Young Red Dragon, Red Dragon, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Reforging & reagents for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.
